{"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1794720008718,"sessionID":"ses_e225d5f9cffew4kyaKWphPUdZq","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"bash","callID":"UUjpz480xQ5TzPJF","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"command":"python3 -c '\nimport random, math\n\n# Simulate departments: 9, 6, 7, 7, 11\ndepts = [0]*9 + [1]*6 + [2]*7 + [3]*7 + [4]*11\n\n# How fast do regular leaks narrow down suspects?\n# Suppose each day 3 docs published, each to 2 random depts.\n# Mole leaks w.p. 0.65, delay 2 or 3 days.\ndef sim(plant_day1=False, n_trials=5000):\n    # Estimate day caught and canary cost\n    scores = []\n    for _ in range(n_trials):\n        mole = random.randrange(40)\n        # Track docs per day\n        docs = [] # (day, recips, is_canary, variants)\n        leaks = [] # (surface_day, doc_idx, shown_var)\n        leaked_set = set()\n        canaries_cost = 0.0\n        \n        suspects = set(range(40))\n        # Decoy known day 2 (1 random non-mole removed)\n        decoy = random.choice([i for i in range(40) if i != mole])\n        \n        caught_day = 21\n        for day in range(1, 22):\n            if day == 2:\n                suspects.discard(decoy)\n            # Check surfaced leaks today\n            for sday, didx, svar in leaks:\n                if sday == day:\n                    _, recips, is_c, vars_map = docs[didx]\n                    suspects &= recips\n                    if is_c:\n                        # 95% accurate, simplify: if <=2 in var, might still need confirmation or logs\n                        # In reality Bayes handles 0.95; say if var has mole (95%), narrows mostly to var\n                        suspects_var = suspects & {e for e, v in vars_map.items() if v == svar}\n                        if len(suspects_var) > 0:\n                            suspects = suspects_var # approx\n            if len(suspects) == 1:\n                caught_day = day\n                break\n                \n            # Publish regular docs today\n            nd = random.choice([2, 3, 4])\n            for _ in range(nd):\n                d1, d2 = random.sample(range(5), 2)\n                recips = {e for e in range(40) if depts[e] in (d1, d2)}\n                docs.append((day, recips, False, None))\n                \n            # Canary strategy\n            if plant_day1 and day == 1:\n                # 2 canaries: 19 and 19 covering 38 people orthogonally across depts\n                # group by dept\n                by_d = [[e for e in range(40) if depts[e] == d] for d in range(5)]\n                c1, c2 = {}, {}\n                for d_list in by_d:\n                    half = len(d_list)//2\n                    for idx, e in enumerate(d_list[:half]):\n                        c1[e] = idx % 3\n                    for idx, e in enumerate(d_list[half:]):\n                        c2[e] = idx % 3\n                docs.append((day, set(c1.keys()), True, c1))\n                docs.append((day, set(c2.keys()), True, c2))\n                canaries_cost += 0.02\n            elif day >= 3 and len(suspects) <= 18 and len(suspects) > 1:\n                # Plant 1 or 2 targeted canaries if no active canary on suspects\n                active_c = sum(1 for d0, r, ic, _ in docs if ic and day - d0 <= 2 and len(r & suspects) >= len(suspects)//2)\n                if active_c == 0:\n                    s_list = sorted(suspects)\n                    if len(s_list) <= 3:\n                        # Add filler if needed or just 3? Let us use s_list\n                        c1 = {e: idx % 3 for idx, e in enumerate(s_list)}\n                        docs.append((day, set(c1.keys()), True, c1))\n                        canaries_cost += 0.01\n                    else:\n                        c1 = {e: idx % 3 for idx, e in enumerate(s_list)}\n                        c2 = {e: (idx // 3) % 3 for idx, e in enumerate(s_list)}\n                        docs.append((day, set(c1.keys()), True, c1))\n                        if len(s_list) > 3:\n                            docs.append((day, set(c2.keys()), True, c2))\n                            canaries_cost += 0.02\n                        else:\n                            canaries_cost += 0.01\n                            \n            # End of day leak\n            elig = []\n            weights = []\n            for idx, (d0, recips, is_c, _) in enumerate(docs):\n                if day - d0 < 3 and mole in recips and idx not in leaked_set:\n                    elig.append(idx)\n                    weights.append((1.0 - len(recips)/40.0) if is_c else 1.0)\n            if elig and sum(weights) > 0 and random.random() < 0.65:\n                chosen = random.choices(elig, weights=weights, k=1)[0]\n                leaked_set.add(chosen)\n                delay = random.choice([2, 3])\n                _, _, is_c, vmap = docs[chosen]\n                svar = None\n                if is_c:\n                    svar = vmap[mole] # approx 95%\n                leaks.append((day + delay, chosen, svar))\n                \n        v = 1.0 - 0.05 * len(leaks) - canaries_cost\n        scores.append((v, caught_day, len(leaks), canaries_cost))\n    print(f\"plant_day1={str(plant_day1):5s}: avg_V={sum(x[0] for x in scores)/len(scores):.4f}, avg_day={sum(x[1] for x in scores)/len(scores):.2f}, avg_canary_cost={sum(x[3] for x in scores)/len(scores):.4f}\")\n\nsim(False)\nsim(True)\n'"},"output":"plant_day1=False: avg_V=0.4744, avg_day=15.45, avg_canary_cost=0.0652\nplant_day1=True : avg_V=0.5592, avg_day=12.50, avg_canary_cost=0.0671\n","metadata":{"output":"plant_day1=False: avg_V=0.4744, avg_day=15.45, avg_canary_cost=0.0652\nplant_day1=True : avg_V=0.5592, avg_day=12.50, avg_canary_cost=0.0671\n","exit":0,"truncated":false},"title":"python3 -c '\nimport random, math\n\n# Simulate departments: 9, 6, 7, 7, 11\ndepts = [0]*9 + [1]*6 + [2]*7 + [3]*7 + [4]*11\n\n# How fast do regular leaks narrow down suspects?\n# Suppose each day 3 docs published, each to 2 random depts.\n# Mole leaks w.p. 0.65, delay 2 or 3 days.\ndef sim(plant_day1=False, n_trials=5000):\n    # (surface_day, doc_idx, shown_var)\n        leaked_set = set()\n        canaries_cost = 0.0\n        \n        suspects = set(range(40))\n        # Decoy known day 2 (1 random non-mole removed)\n        decoy = random.choice([i for i in range(40) if i != mole])\n        \n        caught_day = 21\n        for day in range(1, 22):\n            if day == 2:\n                suspects.discard(decoy)\n            # Check surfaced leaks today\n            for sday, didx, svar in leaks:\n                if sday == day:\n                    _, recips, is_c, vars_map = docs[didx]\n                    suspects &= recips\n                    if is_c:\n                        # 95% accurate, simplify: if <=2 in var, might still need confirmation or logs\n                        # In reality Bayes handles 0.95; say if var has mole (95%), narrows mostly to var\n                        suspects_var = suspects & {e for e, v in vars_map.items() if v == svar}\n                        if len(suspects_var) > 0:\n                            suspects = suspects_var # approx\n            if len(suspects) == 1:\n                caught_day = day\n                break\n                \n            # Publish regular docs today\n            nd = random.choice([2, 3, 4])\n            for _ in range(nd):\n                d1, d2 = random.sample(range(5), 2)\n                recips = {e for e in range(40) if depts[e] in (d1, d2)}\n                docs.append((day, recips, False, None))\n                \n            # Canary strategy\n            if plant_day1 and day == 1:\n                # 2 canaries: 19 and 19 covering 38 people orthogonally across depts\n                # group by dept\n                by_d = [[e for e in range(40) if depts[e] == d] for d in range(5)]\n                c1, c2 = {}, {}\n                for d_list in by_d:\n                    half = len(d_list)//2\n                    for idx, e in enumerate(d_list[:half]):\n                        c1[e] = idx % 3\n                    for idx, e in enumerate(d_list[half:]):\n                        c2[e] = idx % 3\n                docs.append((day, set(c1.keys()), True, c1))\n                docs.append((day, set(c2.keys()), True, c2))\n                canaries_cost += 0.02\n            elif day >= 3 and len(suspects) <= 18 and len(suspects) > 1:\n                # Plant 1 or 2 targeted canaries if no active canary on suspects\n                active_c = sum(1 for d0, r, ic, _ in docs if ic and day - d0 <= 2 and len(r & suspects) >= len(suspects)//2)\n                if active_c == 0:\n                    s_list = sorted(suspects)\n                    if len(s_list) <= 3:\n                        # Add filler if needed or just 3? Let us use s_list\n                        c1 = {e: idx % 3 for idx, e in enumerate(s_list)}\n                        docs.append((day, set(c1.keys()), True, c1))\n                        canaries_cost += 0.01\n                    else:\n                        c1 = {e: idx % 3 for idx, e in enumerate(s_list)}\n                        c2 = {e: (idx // 3) % 3 for idx, e in enumerate(s_list)}\n                        docs.append((day, set(c1.keys()), True, c1))\n                        if len(s_list) > 3:\n                            docs.append((day, set(c2.keys()), True, c2))\n                            canaries_cost += 0.02\n                        else:\n                            canaries_cost += 0.01\n                            \n            # End of day leak\n            elig = []\n            weights = []\n            for idx, (d0, recips, is_c, _) in enumerate(docs):\n                if day - d0 < 3 and mole in recips and idx not in leaked_set:\n                    elig.append(idx)\n                    weights.append((1.0 - len(recips)/40.0) if is_c else 1.0)\n            if elig and sum(weights) > 0 and random.random() < 0.65:\n                chosen = random.choices(elig, weights=weights, k=1)[0]\n                leaked_set.add(chosen)\n                delay = random.choice([2, 3])\n                _, _, is_c, vmap = docs[chosen]\n                svar = None\n                if is_c:\n                    svar = vmap[mole] # approx 95%\n                leaks.append((day + delay, chosen, svar))\n                \n        v = 1.0 - 0.05 * len(leaks) - canaries_cost\n        scores.append((v, caught_day, len(leaks), canaries_cost))\n    print(f\"plant_day1={str(plant_day1):5s}: avg_V={sum(x[0] for x in scores)/len(scores):.4f}, avg_day={sum(x[1] for x in scores)/len(scores):.2f}, avg_canary_cost={sum(x[3] for x in scores)/len(scores):.4f}\")\n\nsim(False)\nsim(True)\n'","time":{"start":1794720007620,"end":1794720008716}},"metadata":{"google":{"thoughtSignature":""}},"id":"prt_1dda605b2001ntN6LjeF628VG9","sessionID":"ses_e225d5f9cffew4kyaKWphPUdZq","messageID":"msg_1dda51600001Y5hP7X0NHO1H4g"}}

exclude decoy 39\n        docs = []\n        leaks = []\n        leaked_set = set()\n        canaries_cost = 0.02 # Day 1 c1, c2\n        suspects = set(range(39))\n        \n        # Day 1 docs + 2 canaries\n        for d1, d2 in [(1,3), (0,2), (3,4), (0,1)]:\n            docs.append((1, {e for e in range(40) if depts[e] in (d1, d2)}, False, None))\n        by_d = [[e for e in range(40) if depts[e] == d] for d in range(5)]\n        c1, c2 = {}, {}\n        for d_list in by_d:\n            half = len(d_list)//2\n            for idx, e in enumerate(d_list[:half]): c1[e] = idx % 3\n            for idx, e in enumerate(d_list[half:]): c2[e] = idx % 3\n        docs.append((1, set(c1.keys()), True, c1))\n        docs.append((1, set(c2.keys()), True, c2))\n        \n        caught_day = 21\n        for day in range(1, 22):\n            if day >= 2:\n                for sday, didx, svar in leaks:\n                    if sday == day:\n                        _, recips, is_c, vars_map = docs[didx]\n                        suspects &= recips\n                        if is_c:\n                            sv = suspects & {e for e, v in vars_map.items() if v == svar}\n                            if sv: suspects = sv\n                if len(suspects) == 1:\n                    caught_day = day\n                    break\n                nd = random.choice([2, 3, 4])\n                for _ in range(nd):\n                    d1, d2 = random.sample(range(5), 2)\n                    docs.append((day, {e for e in range(40) if depts[e] in (d1, d2)}, False, None))\n                if day == 2 and plant_day2:\n                    # 2 orthogonal canaries of size 20\n                    all_e = list(range(40))\n                    random.shuffle(all_e)\n                    ca = {e: idx % 3 for idx, e in enumerate(all_e[:20])}\n                    cb = {e: idx % 3 for idx, e in enumerate(all_e[20:])}\n                    docs.append((day, set(ca.keys()), True, ca))\n                    docs.append((day, set(cb.keys()), True, cb))\n                    canaries_cost += 0.02\n                elif day >= 3 and 1 < len(suspects) <= 18:\n                    active_c = sum(1 for d0, r, ic, _ in docs if ic and day - d0 <= 2 and len(r & suspects) >= max(2, len(suspects)//2) and len(r) <= 20)\n                    # Wait: on day 3, day 1 canaries have len(r)=19,21. Only plant new if len(suspects) <= 18 and we want narrower split!\n                    narrow_c = sum(1 for d0, r, ic, _ in docs if ic and day - d0 <= 2 and len(r) <= 18)\n                    if narrow_c == 0:\n                        s_list = sorted(suspects)\n                        ca = {e: idx % 3 for idx, e in enumerate(s_list)}\n                        docs.append((day, set(ca.keys()), True, ca))\n                        canaries_cost += 0.01\n                        if len(s_list) > 3:\n                            cb = {e: (idx // 3) % 3 for idx, e in enumerate(s_list)}\n                            docs.append((day, set(cb.keys()), True, cb))\n                            canaries_cost += 0.01\n            elig, weights = [], []\n            for idx, (d0, recips, is_c, _) in enumerate(docs):\n                if day - d0 < 3 and mole in recips and idx not in leaked_set:\n                    elig.append(idx)\n                    weights.append((1.0 - len(recips)/40.0) if              delay = random.choice([2, 3])\n                _, _, is_c, vmap = docs[chosen]\n                leaks.append((day + delay, chosen, vmap[mole] if is_c else None))\n        v = 1.0 - 0.05 * len(leaks) - canaries_cost\n        scores.append((v, caught_day, canaries_cost))\n    print(f\"plant_day2={str(plant_day2):5s}: avg_V={sum(x[0] for x in scores)/len(scores):.4f}, avg_day={sum(x[1]   \"e34\": (0, 0),\n}\n\n# Poisson log-likelihood over T=6 days:\n# Mole: normal ~ Pois(6 * 0.7), after_hours ~ Pois(6 * 0.3) (0 fake accesses!)\n# Innocent (non-decoy): normal ~ Pois(6 * 0.9), after_hours ~ Pois(6 * (0.1 + 1.0/38 + rule_frame))\n# Let us check with rule_frame = 0 and rule_frame = 1/39:\nfor rf in [0.0, 1.0/39.0]:\n    lam_norm_m, lam_ah_m = 6 * 0.7, 6 * 0.3\n    lam_norm_i, lam_ah_i = 6 * 0.9, 6 * (0.1 + 1.0/38.0 + rf)\n    scores = {}\n    for e, var in c2_vars.items():\n        # Canary variant likelihood\n        p_var = 0.95 if var == \"C\" else 0.025\n        n_norm, n_ah = logs[e]\n        # Log LR from logs:\n        # Pois(k; lam_m) / Pois(k; lam_i) = exp(-(lam_m - lam_i)) * (lam_m / lam_i)^k\n        log_lr_logs = -(lam_norm_m - lam_norm_i) + n_norm *
